name: Kubernetes
description: Configures Kubernetes with DuploCloud JIT authentication and VS Code extensions.

version.description: Version of kubectl to install. Defaults to 1.32 to avoid upstream bugs with 'latest'.

jit.description: Enable automatic JIT authentication with duploctl on container creation.

jitAdmin.description: Use admin privileges when authenticating (requires admin token). Adds --admin flag.

jitInteractive.description: Use interactive browser authentication. Adds --interactive flag. Cannot be used in non-interactive devcontainers.

plan.description: DuploCloud plan/infrastructure name for JIT. Alternative to DUPLO_PLAN env var. Requires admin to be true.

tenant.description: DuploCloud tenant name to scope into. Alternative to DUPLO_TENANT env var.
